promise: Build the claim from evidence, keep the limits, and make the work inspectable.
audience: People and agents doing evidence synthesis, experiments, or scientific writing.
trigger: Use when a decision needs sources, an empirical claim needs a study, or a paper needs an auditable evidence chain.

modes.name: Investigate
modes.when: A question needs a bounded multi-source answer.
modes.output: A source and claim map, contradictions, applicability, and open gaps.

modes.name: Experiment
modes.when: A hypothesis has executable measurements and a justified budget.
modes.output: A frozen protocol, retained trials, integrity checks, and cautious inference.

modes.name: Write
modes.when: Evidence is ready for a paper, brief, or technical report.
modes.output: A claim-linked manuscript with real citations, figures, methods, and limitations.

examples.title: A high score built from broken trials
examples.brief: A fictional experiment reports an apparent gain after several provider errors and a favorable model judge.
examples.before: Average only the successes, call the judge independent, and write an improvement claim.
examples.after: Keep errors in the declared denominator, audit manifests and traces, inspect judgment semantics, retain null/disputed outcomes, and withhold the claim until a valid comparison exists.
examples.why: An attractive number cannot repair a compromised measurement process.

boundaries: A literature basis is not a measured result of this skill. Model judgments are fallible measurements.
Optional statistical, audit, resume, provenance, and paper-generation engines retain their native dependencies.
Do not begin a costly live experiment, generate paid media, or publish a manuscript without existing authorization.

verification.name: Six native integrity tool suites
verification.command: For each modules/tool-experiment-*/: PYTHONPATH=<module>/src python -m pytest <module>/tests -q
verification.evidence: 174 tests: audit 50; block hypothesis 22; power 40; provenance 19; resume 14; stage analyzer 29. Isolated Python 3.12.11 with recorded test dependencies. No new empirical study or live model comparison.
verification.expected: The stated scope passes; no broader result inferred.

verification.name: Autonomous experiment-loop shell checks
verification.evidence: 10 shell checks passed, including freeze gate, append-only ledger, keep/revert, promotion rules, attribution, templates, and an isolated three-row smoke loop. Synthetic plumbing, not empirical benefit.
verification.expected: The stated scope passes; no broader result inferred.

verification.name: Portable packaging and install
verification.command: python3 scripts/capability.py build; python3 scripts/capability.py check; python3 scripts/capability.py doctor; python3 scripts/capability.py install --dest <temporary-parent> (twice)
verification.expected: Byte-identical canonical ZIP and isolated idempotent install.
verification.evidence: All operations passed. No runtime activation or effectiveness measured.

verification.name: Skill discovery metadata
verification.expected: Valid required frontmatter, naming, and complete scaffold.
verification.evidence: Skill is valid. This is a structural check, not a behavioral benchmark.
